body.text: Overview and Empirical Foundations of MEMS
Every leap in modern computing traces back to breakthroughs like MEMS. Look past the hype and you find concrete engineering trade-offs in speed, energy efficiency, and system architecture.

MEMS (micro-electromechanical systems) is the technology of microscopic devices incorporating both electronic and moving parts. , digital micromirror devices) can be more than 1000 mm2. They usually consist of a central unit that processes data (an integrated circuit chip such as microprocessor) and several components that interact with the surroundings (such as microsensors).
